_comment: Seller-first INDEX options engine (NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/FINNIFTY), living in src/options/ alongside the buyer-first structures (config/execution.json:options_execution) — not a separate tree. When this master switch is false, no seller-desk loop initializes (zero overhead, equity engine untouched). European index options only; stock options deferred. Full decision+execution pipeline is wired (seller_desk.py) and runs every 5 minutes. Only strategies marked enabled BELOW *and* implemented in structure_builder.py are ever traded — currently 10 types: the 8 verticals/straddles/strangles (bull_put_spread/bear_call_spread/bull_call_spread/bear_put_spread/iron_condor/iron_butterfly/long_straddle/long_strangle) plus calendar_spread/diagonal_spread, which ARE fully built (ChainFetcher.fetch_tier2 multi-expiry support exists, seller_desk.run_cycle already calls them on backwardation, tests pass) and enabled 2026-09-04 after verifying the earlier 'no multi-expiry chain support' note here was stale. protective_put/collar have no builder and stay disabled — that trigger (existing CNC equity position + earnings proximity) is already handled by the buyer-first src/options/structure_selector.py, not duplicated here.

options_trading._capital_note: RING-FENCED fixed rupee sleeve, isolated from equity buying power. ALL Greeks budgets and position sizing key off this number. Must be > 0 before enabling (boot validation enforces when enabled=true). Spec example uses 400000.

universe._indices_note: FINNIFTY removed 2026-09-28. Measured on the live Oct-27 chain: OTM bid-ask spreads 67-195% and OI 0 at every target-delta strike (BANKNIFTY same expiry: ~1%, OI in the thousands), so the liquidity gate rejected every structure 1,100+ times and any paper fill would have been a fantasy at mid. Re-add only if its chain shows two-sided quotes within the 5% spread rule at the 0.25/0.10 delta strikes.
universe._stocks_note: Empty and non-configurable in this phase. Stock options deferred.

operator_actions._note: Details removed from the public copy.

options_trading._strategy_order_note: Credit spreads (bull_put_spread / bear_call_spread) are brought up FIRST per operator decision — 2-leg, smaller naked-exposure surface than the 4-leg Iron Condor.

iv_thresholds._note: Read by strategy_selector.py's _menu()/_reduced_size_ivr_band() -- previously loaded into orchestrator.py's _seller_iv_cfg and never used at all (dead config, found+fixed 2026-09-04); the OLD keys here (sell_min_ivr/buy_max_ivr/iron_butterfly_min_ivr:65) disagreed with the actual hardcoded enforcement (iron_condor:55/iron_butterfly:70/reduced-band 25-55) -- these are now the real, single source of truth. iron_condor_min_ivr/iron_butterfly_min_ivr are the full-size IVR floor for range-bound structures; reduced_size_min_ivr/reduced_size_max_ivr is the [lo,hi) band where single-sided credit spreads (bull_put_spread/bear_call_spread) fire at half size instead of not at all.

strike_deltas._note: Target deltas for strike selection (structure_builder.py). credit_short/credit_long are the spec's own bull_put_spread numbers (options_spec.md §4); atm/strangle_otm are NOT spec-given, documented reasonable defaults (see structure_builder.py module docstring). Defaults here match what was previously hardcoded -- changing these is a real trading-behavior change, not a config-extraction no-op.

dte_ranges._note: Optimal (min_dte, max_dte) per strategy type (options_spec.md §6 table), read by expiry_selector.py. Types not listed here get the (0, 999) no-restriction fallback. Defaults match what was previously hardcoded.

low_ivr_mode._paper_trial_note: Mirrors config/global.json agent_intelligence.paper_trial_days_before_live's convention. options_positions.realized_pnl is now populated at close (fixed 2026-09-04, seller_desk._close_position -> OptionsRepository.close_position) -- but it's an LTP-captured-before-the-close-order APPROXIMATION, not a confirmed fill (no fill-polling exists on this path), and NULL (not 0) whenever a leg's LTP fetch failed at close. Promotion decisions should still be a manual review of options_positions rows (WHERE strategy_type IN ('bull_put_spread','bear_call_spread') AND opened_at >= this-date), not an automated gate -- no promotion-checker script exists yet, and realized_pnl's fill-price approximation isn't precise enough on its own to auto-decide real-money promotion.
low_ivr_mode._paper_mode_pointer: The real paper/live switch stays config/global.json system.segments.options.paper_mode -- flip that to false when ready, same as every other options change. paper_trial_days_before_live above is a minimum HOLD before considering that, not a separate switch.

Edit config/capital.json instead.
options_trading._sizing_removed_note: 2026-10-07 Phase 4: sizing (risk_per_trade_pct/min_lots) removed -- the desk's per-trade budget is now derived at boot from config/capital.json options.max_structure_loss_per_strategy x live equity (src/orchestrator.py _seller_risk_per_trade_pct), so it auto-scales with capital instead of being a fixed % of the options_capital_rupees sleeve below. Confirmed zero remaining readers of this block before removal.

adjustments._note: execute_rolls is the master switch for actually placing roll orders (close/open the untested income leg) when a delta breach fires. Enabled 2026-09-15 after 4 days of paper-mode delta-breach observation with no roll ever executed.

profit_and_stop._note: 2026-09-28: debit_stop_loss_pct was 100 = 'stop at TOTAL loss' = no stop; a NIFTY bull_call_spread bled to -55..-70% of its debit with no exit. 50 = cut a broken directional thesis at half the debit (max loss is already capped, so the goal is to keep half, not to widen). debit_breakeven_lock_arm_pct: once a debit spread has been up this % of the debit, exit if P&L returns to zero -- a winner must not become a loser.

options_expiry_day._note_strangle: Details removed from the public copy.

options_intraday_short_premium._note: options_intraday_short_premium (docs/hypotheses/I_options_intraday_short_premium.md), added 2026-10-12, PAPER first. NAME IS DELIBERATELY GENERIC: the same code is a short STRADDLE (offsets 0/0), a short STRANGLE (default +150/-150) or an iron fly/condor (wing_points > 0). target_pct (0 = off, as tested): when TOTAL profit (open legs + legs already stopped) reaches target_pct % of the net credit, every remaining leg is closed. EVERYTHING HERE IS A PERCENTAGE, never a rupee amount. LOTS: lots 0 = AUTO-SIZED from the percentage budget -- the all-legs-stopped loss of N lots must fit risk_fraction_of_daily_cap (0.8) x capital.json options.max_loss_per_day_per_strategy (a % of live equity), so lots grow with equity automatically; lots > 0 forces a fixed count; max_lots is a sanity ceiling. Daily NIFTY weekly short strangle: SELL the ATM+ce_offset_points CALL and ATM+pe_offset_points PUT at entry_time (retried every poll for entry_grace_minutes, max 2 attempts), each leg stopped alone when its price reaches entry premium x (1 + sl_pct/100) (sl_pct_ce / sl_pct_pe override per side), whatever is left closed at exit_time. No rolls/adjustments. Defaults = the user's StockMock run: ce +150 / pe -150 (0/0 = straddle), 10:30 -> 15:01, 23%, Wednesday skipped. EVERY value is read fresh each tick (no restart). Runs inside SellerDesk but is exempt from open-position / trades-per-day / exposure / shared-risk caps; still obeys entry breakers (daily-loss, margin cushion), its own per-strategy daily-loss cap (capital.json), the CRM gates, and G9 when registry llm_gate_required is true. wing_points 0 = naked shorts, allowed ONLY with allow_naked true (operator decision 2026-10-12); wing_points > 0 buys protective wings that many points beyond each short. exit_time must be <= 15:10 (guardian backstop stage is 15:15). llm_shadow: when the LLM gate is off, still log a NON-blocking LLM verdict per trade so on/off can be compared. Switches: this 'enabled' AND registry options_intraday_short_premium 'enabled'; paper/live = registry execution_mode.

portfolio_risk._note: daily_loss_halt_pct REMOVED 2026-10-07 (Phase 4) -- superseded by config/capital.json options.max_loss_per_day_all_strategies x live equity (src/options/seller_settings.max_options_daily_loss_all_strategies_rupees()), confirmed zero remaining readers of the old key. Edit config/capital.json instead. gap_risk_enforce (the only key still read here): run the 5-scenario gap stress test every sweep and always LOG the worst 5%/10% loss; only when true does a breach also block new entries. Left false until the stress-test units (entry-time Greeks, vega scaling) are validated against live paper positions.

options_trading._nse_limit_note: NSE enforces client-level OI limits. A 4-leg Iron Condor counts as 4x notional. Breach = ENTIRE F&O account frozen. total_oi = sum(lots x lot_size x futures_price) across ALL legs ALL positions. Check runs atomically with margin + Greeks budget as 3-way gate.
